violations.text: Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the back kitchen. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

(Various food product) was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

(Desserts ) packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026
Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the (storage ) area. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces of have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -stove hoods -cooking equipment -prep tables shelves -food storage shelves -equipment storage shelves New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

The floors and walls throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

The door to the outside, located in the back area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 04/24/2026
The doors to the toilet rooms are not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 04/24/2026
The grease recycling receptacle has an accumulation of grease and debris. The grease receptacle must be cleaned or replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026

The floor and wall junctures in some areas of the kitchen do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 04/24/2026

The electrical conduit near cooking equipment has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 04/23/2026
